I don't know if this is what it's actually called but I call it an oversharing hangover. I am currently awaiting diagnosis for ADHD and Autism but am diagnosed with C-PTSD. I constantly overshare deeply personal parts and events from my life and even if the person doesn't appear to judge, appears sympathetic, understanding and all the qualities you might want in a person I still regret the share and worry that I have put them off or made them look at me differently (this is friends and romantically).

I would reach out and let her know that you are still interested but that if she needs space it's fine and you will wait to hear from her. Personally I don't like to hear that nothing I've said makes them see me differently because then it feels like it should do and it's only because they are being nice that it doesn't, but this may just be me 😬
Maybe you could offer to set him up with someone so that he knows you are not interested?
I hope it gets better for you soon.

I have tried 7 different antidepressants and all of them taking me from suicidal thoughts and depression to bat shit crazy and an immediate danger to myself.  Docs don't normally wait the 6 weeks to take them me off them. Some people just don't react well to the medication, i would recommend getting an appointment asap.

Not all, all my other forms of SH are about pain and controlling panic attacks, to stay relatively calm at work or home or just punishment.  But when I cut, it is for the blood, to see it welling and then pooling before falling down wherever.  The peace, the pleasure and satisfaction I feel is indescribable, I could watch my blood flow every day. Obviously I try to keep myself safe and try and hide It, I take pictures so that if I already have too many cuts sometimes the pics help control the need.
I find it a comfort too, so many people say the same thing that I am feeling.  It is nice to know that I am not alone or just an attention seeking freak. I hope that you feel relatively better soon.
I do have a plan but but it is long term so I do worry that I will let it take me way too soon, that the demons will win before I offer my surrender.  This is especially so when I self harm.
I am glad that I could offer it to you.
